stories.title: CISA Adds Four Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
stories.summary: CISA has added four new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog , based on evidence of active exploitation.

stories.title: CISA: Medusa ransomware hit over 500 critical infrastructure orgs
